title: Preserve prospective Quest contracts and recorded practice supports

source.ref: Owner-directed canonical queue tracking; reviewed local Quest61000 feature remains queued behind actual Growth60000 release.

detail: Queue tracking only: actual main still uses the legacy Expression-required completion function, and the unchanged consequence probe fails its prospective optional-Expression assertion against that real source. Both existing frozen Quest policy/fan-out probes are copied byte-identically; no backend, UI, SQL or reward behavior ships in this tracking slice. The independently reviewed local Quest61000 candidate0eb6ade0992ddc04ae8762385f3d096fc07298ec is prepared with28 owned paths, immutable canonical multi-support log evidence and prospective fixed-window enrollment contracts. Legacy qualification, the14-day threshold, rank eligibility, reward values, grant keys and earned recognition remain unchanged in that candidate. A missing-season render regression was corrected without inventing Expression completion. Local96 focused tests,20 changed-file lint files, frozen probes, schema/grant checks and backlog passed; those are preparation evidence, not main or production acceptance. The Quest SQL is NOT applied or on main. Growth60000 must actually be applied and merged first; then Quest needs a proper main-based feature PR, fresh full reviewed source inventory/registration, exact-head full replay and eight real Auth/API acceptance checks, current-main trusted readiness, all normal checks and real artifact acceptance. The new enrollment columns are read independently of the graph-reader flag, so the exact Quest SQL must be applied before merging its application source. The prepared .env.example leaves PRACTICE_SUPPORT_EVIDENCE_ENABLED blank, and this lane has not enabled it; the actual Vercel flag was not inspected. No feature source, SQL, provider send, flag activation or Claude work changes here. The future proper Quest feature updates this same OPEN row to done only when its unchanged consequence probe passes on that source.
